onlyInA.text: Fetch API cannot load https://api-east.wegmans.com/stores — net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED

insight.summary: This eastus2 run can't reach api-east.wegmans.com — a request refused only in this region, while the baseline reached it.

findings.title: Region IP not allow-listed
findings.detail: api-east.wegmans.com refused the connection only in eastus2; the baseline run reached it. Likely a region/IP allow-list gap.

caveats: This compares two single runs — confirm with another eastus2 failure before treating it as a standing regional issue.
